title: Buying a second Simca Aronde A90 Elysee in spring 2022
author: Caramagnols
excerpt: After the August 2021 fire, the point was not to replace the car quickly, but to find another Aronde that felt right in presentation, condition and future use.
content:
In spring 2022, our search for another Aronde begins with a very concrete absence. The first car had been lost in the August 2021 fire, and what we needed was not an ideal copy but a saloon able to return to real family and road use.

Starting from use rather than abstract nostalgia

After a loss, the temptation is to look for exactly the same car. In practice, the right starting point was simpler: to find an A90 Elysee that could drive, live outside from time to time, cover calm trips and return to our daily habits.

That method changes everything. One no longer looks only at colour or memory. One first looks at the state of the base, the readability of work already done and the remaining margin for sensible correction.

What we checked before deciding

Before purchase, the useful points stay the same as on many Simcas of this generation: floors, sills, door fit, coherence of the trim, engine behaviour when cold and warm, and paperwork that truly belongs to the car.

An Aronde that looks charming in photographs is not enough. We wanted a readable car, not an attractive assembly. Once the details agree with each other, the decision becomes calmer and stronger.

Why this A90 Elysee was the right one

The car found in spring 2022 was not perfect, yet it spoke clearly. Its presentation stayed faithful to the model, its condition allowed driving without moving straight into a full restoration, and it kept the modest tone we value in the Aronde.

That is often where a good collector-car purchase is decided. The right car is not the most showy one. It is the one whose overall balance lets the story continue without strain.
